title: Sicilian Defense: Accelerated Dragon
line: The bishop comes out early, and the queen's pawn waits to go two squares in one move.

steps.text: Here Black's knight came out before the pawn in front of the queen moved, and White took in the center.
Push the pawn on g7 one square, to make room for your bishop.

also.g8f6: That works too. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.text: Put the bishop on g7, on the long diagonal.

steps.after: White's bishop takes a quiet road to e2. This is one quiet setup; against a bishop on c4 Black plays differently.

steps.text: Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
Your pawn on d7 has not moved yet, so it can go two squares in one move and strike at the center.
Tap the white piece that your queen, your knight and your bishop all attack.
steps.after: It is attacked three times and guarded twice. If White leaves it, Black can take it and come out a knight ahead.

summary: In the Accelerated Dragon the queen's pawn waits at home, then goes two squares at once to strike at the center.
